Metadata.title: ToPWR | Your student assistant
Metadata.description: First day of classes and it's already an odd Wednesday on a Monday? A building with the cryptic name C-13 in your timetable? Or maybe you're looking for information about faculties and student research groups? Every student at WUST asks similar questions, so we know how hard it is to get a handle on university life. We created ToPWR to simplify everyday student challenges!

AppFeatures.title: Student life can be simpler!
AppFeatures.description: See how our student toolkit makes every part of university life easier.

campusMap.title: Campus map
campusMap.description: No more getting lost between buildings. Our multi-layer map will guide you straight to the right door.

parkings.title: Parking
parkings.description: Fighting for a spot at 7:55? Check parking availability in real time and park with ease.

sksMenu.title: SKS menu
sksMenu.description: Mark your favorite dish, and we'll notify you as soon as it's on the menu!

studentOrganizations.title: Student organizations
studentOrganizations.description: Discover research clubs and other student organizations at your university where you can grow.

radioLuz.title: Radio LUZ
radioLuz.description: Student radio at your fingertips — listen straight from our app.

Changelog.title: Changelog
Changelog.description: Follow what's new in ToPWR with every update.

isFree.question: Is ToPWR free?
isFree.answer: Yes — ToPWR is completely free and ad-free. Get it from the App Store and Google Play with no fees, subscriptions or hidden costs.
